oracle.why: This is the direct parser used by the most-downloaded current npm Obsidian-flavored Markdown integration. npm's official point API reported 43,766 direct-package downloads for 2026-08-23..2026-08-29; the 44,174-download umbrella package delegates parsing to it.

candidateDownloads.note: umbrella transformer; delegates parsing to the selected package

metadataOracle.runner: exact Obsidian envelope scanner / yaml Document API with CST source tokens
metadataOracle.why: This repository has no runnable Obsidian host for the offline gate. Obsidian exposes parseYaml, but that public API does not document the source-preserving evidence this AST needs. The pinned yaml Document/CST API supplies ordered pairs, decoded scalar values, original scalar sources, comments, and ranges. It is a syntax witness within the Properties domain, not Obsidian's implementation or a mandate to support the library's complete language. The recorded npm week reported 202,359,392 downloads.

metadataOracle.authorityBoundary: The repository Properties module owns ten fixed fields, scalar, bracketed-array and block-list forms, and bare literal | prose on abstract/comment. The YAML oracle compares only their valid intersection, without expanding aliases, tags or folded scalars. Unsupported product members are ignored; metadata directly holds ten optional named fields with only the envelope scope. JSON root objects are outside the format; arrays remain field values.

claim: For the documented constructs the selected package actually parses, Markdown Core must converge on the same semantic recognition except for explicit, general AST-model deltas. The official Obsidian documentation, not this package, owns the language contract.

modelDeltas.summary: The oracle removes every %% comment while parsing, and drops a paragraph the removal leaves empty. Markdown Core emits a Comment node for each and strips nothing.
modelDeltas.handling: The comparison projects the product tree by dropping Comment nodes and then any Paragraph left with no children; canaries assert that the oracle removes `%%hidden%%` and that the product parses it as one Comment inside one Paragraph, so agreement is recognition on both sides rather than absence.

modelDeltas.summary: The oracle emits the complete highlight body as one Text child. Markdown Core parses Mark.content as inline content, like emphasis and strikethrough.
modelDeltas.handling: The comparison retains children for plain-text recognition witnesses. A formatted-mark canary separately asserts the raw oracle Text and the product Text/Emphasis/Text children; nested-format product fixtures own that deliberate content-model difference.

modelDeltas.summary: mdast uses half-open unist points with JavaScript string offsets while Markdown Core publishes inherited inclusive line/column scopes.
modelDeltas.handling: The comparison omits scopes on both sides. Product correctness and shared canonical fixtures own positions.

modelDeltas.summary: The oracle collapses an absent wikilink label delimiter to an empty alias string, while the target model distinguishes an absent label from an authored empty label.
modelDeltas.handling: The projection consults the node's exact source spelling and maps the oracle's empty alias to null only when no label delimiter was authored.

modelDeltas.summary: mdast stores ordinary link/image URLs and wikilink path/heading components as flat fields. The target model stores one tagged Destination value.
modelDeltas.handling: The semantic projection wraps ordinary link/image URLs in Destination.url and wikilinks in Destination.cross; both heading and block spellings populate the same optional anchor after source punctuation is removed.

modelDeltas.summary: mdast stores an image's alt text as one string, while the target Image owns parsed inline content.
modelDeltas.handling: The semantic projection maps a non-empty mdast alt string to one Text child. The corpus exercises the plain-text intersection; product fixtures own nested inline image-alt structure.

modelDeltas.summary: mdast names every inherited > container blockquote, while the canonical AST uses Callout for both metadata-free and metadata-bearing quoted containers (M3).
modelDeltas.handling: The semantic projection maps mdast blockquote to Callout. The inherited source grammar remains owned by CommonMark; official product fixtures own optional Obsidian metadata.

modelDeltas.summary: Only ten fixed metadata fields produce records. Unsupported and unnamed input is ignored within a complete envelope; abstract/comment additionally accept bare literal prose.
modelDeltas.handling: The independent YAML oracle checks only the selected valid intersection. Product canaries and fixtures verify field recognition, ignored input, recovery and body separation.

notAnAuthorityFor: CommonMark or GFM syntax; the existing cmark and cmark-gfm policies remain primary.
Obsidian dialect changes to inherited CommonMark behavior, including suppression between paired inline HTML tags. The dialect deliberately excludes them.
Tags. The package implements them, but the official OFM extension table does not include them; the gate disables them.
Math delimiter edge cases. The gate disables the package's micromark math extension; documented $ and $$ forms remain under the product formula contract.
Callouts. They are implemented by the umbrella transform after parsing, not by this direct parser package.

Block identifier attachment, inline-footnote recognition, the Cite/Citation/CitationReferent/Footnote consumer projection, or image-size semantics. The selected Markdown comparison does not implement them, so official-example product fixtures own them.

YAML features outside the Properties contract; member-level source retention and recovery; binding-specific coordinates; allocation failure; and parser resource bounds. Product fixtures own these boundaries. The YAML syntax oracle witnesses supported key/value spellings, order, and numeric lexemes. Alias and explicit-tag success coverage belongs to the superseded implementation and must be retired by corrected O6.
Vault resolution, rendering, styling, editor completion, or transclusion. These are outside a parser-only AST.

expectedDivergences.requirement: The marker is a Unicode scalar; the oracle matches one UTF-16 code unit without the Unicode regex flag.
The scalar may itself be a closing bracket; the oracle excludes it.
Only SP, TAB, VT and FF separate a prefix; the oracle accepts Unicode whitespace including NBSP.
The entire structural separator run is removed; the oracle removes only one whitespace character.
The prefix is removed before deciding the first block; the oracle removes it after forming a paragraph.
The authored candidate contains one scalar, before escape decoding; the oracle inspects already-decoded text.
Only the opening line is inspected; the oracle inspects the first paragraph even when it begins later.
